hypotheses.justification: The identity holds for every function F. By definition, pullback Λ F (X, p.2) = F (rescalePoint Λ (X, p.2)) = F (Λ * X, p.2). Let g Y := F (Y, p.2). Mathlib's `deriv_comp_mul_left` (Mathlib/Analysis/Calculus/Deriv/CompMul.lean, `deriv (f <| c * ·) x = c • deriv f (c * x)`) needs no differentiability, because deriv is 0 off the set where the function is differentiable. Applying it pointwise gives deriv (fun X => g (Λ*X)) = fun X => Λ * deriv g (Λ*X). Then `deriv_const_mul_field'` (no hypotheses) and `deriv_comp_mul_left` applied to deriv g give Λ * (Λ * deriv (deriv g) (Λ * p.1)). After rewriting with `iteratedDeriv_succ` and `iteratedDeriv_one`, `ring` closes the goal. For Λ = 0 both sides are 0. So the proof can be rewritten without hF. It can be removed independently of hp, and both can be removed together.

The same argument works at every point p and uses no information about where p lies. deriv_comp_mul_left and deriv_const_mul_field' are equalities of functions or hold at every point, with no hypotheses, so the identity iteratedDeriv 2 (fun X => F (Λ*X, p.2)) p.1 = Λ^2 * iteratedDeriv 2 (fun Y => F (Y, p.2)) (Λ*p.1) holds for all p. hp is mentioned nowhere else in the statement (Λ and p both appear in the conclusion), so deleting it needs no other change to the statement. It can be removed independently of hF, and both can be removed together.
